articles.title: Share Market Highlights: Sensex, Nifty climb on IT rebound; rupee slips to 93.71/USD
articles.description: Sensex, Nifty updates on 20 March 2026:  BSE Sensex rose 326 pts to 74,533 and Nifty 50 gained 112 pts to 23,114, led by IT stocks, while the rupee fell 1.2% to 93.71/USD amid Iran war concerns.
